```{stata,echo=False,block.pre.class="ms-5.w-75"}
adopath
clear all
set obs 300
egen n=seq()
gen eta1=1/(1+0.75*n) //eta=1, etarate=0.75
graph twoway line eta1 n
graph export "out/nkbpn_adjby1.png", as(png) name("Graph") replace

hugocmd attachtoa,hbody(`" class="mypp" path="out/nkbpn_adjby1.png" "') 
```
